title: Luke 19:41-44
subtitle: Thursday of the 33rd Week in Ordinary Time · Rev 5:1-10; Lk 19:41-44
text: As Jesus drew near Jerusalem, he saw the city he loved and wept over it: "If this day you only knew what makes for peace." He grieves what we miss, not to shame us but to call us home. Recognize the hour of his visit today.
imageAlt: Painting of Jesus standing on a rocky hillside among his disciples, one arm raised toward the walled city of Jerusalem in the distance as a pale sun sets
